svg.title: Multiplicity class definition
svg.text: Multiplicity classes: common absolute N_ch bins, percentile labels are tune-dependent
Classes are ONE boundary set shared by all three tunes and both sectors. Labels are percentiles of the MONASH minimum-bias distribution.
A — the common boundary set, on absolute N_ch (|η| < 1, primary charged)
boundary N_ch, and its MONASH-MB percentile
B — the published residual: the same boundary sits at a different percentile in each tune
Maximum residual across all classes: 2.91 pp.
This is NOT the ±3 pp criterion of the per-tune scheme passing. That test asked
whether per-tune boundaries coincide — they do not. This is how far a COMMON boundary's
meaning drifts between tunes, and it is published rather than hidden.
Source: AnalysisScripts/anchors/b4_multiplicity_mb (per-tune minimum-bias N_ch, 170–172 k events each).
Percentiles recomputed here as the fraction strictly below each boundary; they reproduce the published translation table exactly.
